about: [O2] after the critic (m1): on foot at the Yards' corner, the man with the flag answers E - 'Bring a car. Ten to race.' node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/o2_flagfoot.json

steps.look: (() => { const C = N.controller, f = G.wheels.race.flag.fig.pos; const want = Math.atan2(-(f.x - C.pos.x), -(f.z - C.pos.z)); const err = Math.atan2(Math.sin(want - C.yaw), Math.cos(want - C.yaw)); return [Math.round(-err / C.sensitivity), 0]; })()
